# events

## Algorithm

* [Per-event helicity and colour-flow selection](colour-and-helicity-selection.md) - Helicities summed and colours contracted while integrating; each accepted event draws a helicity, then a configuration (AMP2 or channel-cut weight), then a flow ∝ JAMP2 in its ICOLAMP row.
* [Unweighting: accept/reject over per-channel grids and the truncated maximum](unweighting.md) - Draw a channel ∝ w_max_j, accept at w/w_max_j, keep overweights at weight > 1 (efficiency ≤ σ/Σ w_max_j); w_max from MadGraph unwgt.f's truncation ladder, because the scanned extremum never converges.

## Design

* [generate: from an integrate artifact to an event file](generate.md) - generate refuses card, model or PDF mismatch, installs the banked grids and channel weights, draws labels per accepted event and writes LHE; check-events checks a file's structure, not its physics.
* [LHEF reader and writer: records, emit, parse, build, and the source-preserving round trip](lhef-io-design.md) - The lhef module's layers: quick-xml owns the document, fixed-format records are written by hand, and parsed blocks keep their source text so both MadGraph dialects round-trip.
* [The matched event record for the shower](mlm-matched-event-record.md) - What an ickkw = 1 event carries for Pythia's MLM matching: <scales pt_clust_N>, status-2 lines of the clustered configuration, <MGRunCard>, matched SCALUP/AQCDUP.
* [Each flavour-group member writes its own colour-flow table](per-member-colour-flow-tables.md) - Flavour-group members can carry conjugate or crossed colour reps, so each writes its own ColorFlowTags under a fingerprint-matched flow permutation; ambiguity is refused.

## Design Decision

* [LHEF weight strategy: Buffer (IDWTUP = −4) or StochasticRounding (+3)](lhef-weight-strategy.md) - σ is the mean XWGTUP at −4, the sum at −3, XSECUP at +3. Buffer writes pb weights normalised to the integration; StochasticRounding streams floor(w)+Bernoulli unit copies.
* [Several @N processes in one event file: per-part normalisation and <init>](multi-process-normalisation.md) - Each multiplicity's weights are scaled to its integrated σ (overweights kept); one <init> line per @N, XSECUP/XERRUP split by weight share; the header keeps the raw estimate.

## Physics Convention

* [LHE header and event-line field conventions](lhef-record-conventions.md) - What each <init> and <event> field holds: SCALUP the larger record μF, AQCDUP untruncated α_s(μR), AQEDUP, PDFSUP, EBMUP, MOTHUP, SPINUP, pole masses; which are per-event oracles.
* [Status-2 resonance records](resonance-records.md) - MadEvent's addmothers/cut_bw rules for status-2 lines (flag, same-flavour daughters, order, mothers, colour, mass), written for decay chains and for matched events.

## Validation Gate

* [Pythia 8 as the consumer: read-back gate and MadGraph's matching settings](pythia-interop.md) - Pythia must consume every event of our samples, with a colour-mutation negative control; and the settings MadGraph 3.7.1 drives main164 with for MLM (setMad off, qCut 1.5·xqcut).
